title: Document digitisation quality check
bodyMd:
A scanned file passes only if every page is readable. Passing files are a subset of the scanned files for that batch.

| Category | Scanned files | Files passing |
|---|---:|---:|
| Batch Cedar | 200 | 180 |
| Batch Elm | 250 | 200 |
| Batch Pine | 350 | 315 |
